title: Augmented K-flat Koszul representative of an open section
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], U a quasi-compact open, and E an arbitrary object of D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Write Q for localization of cochain complexes, T=O_X[0] for the tensor-unit complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and R for open restriction followed by the canonical over-site equivalence. For every morphism s:R(Q(T)) → R(E), there exist a K-flat complex J [def-pc-kflat-complex] with Q(J) perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], a chain augmentation u:J → T, and ξ:Q(J) → E. The morphism R(Q(u)) is invertible and R(Q(u)) followed by s equals R(ξ). No perfectness or boundedness of E is required.

source.place: Tags 08DC and 08DD, equation-comparison and proposition-represent-cohomology-class-on-open; Tag 08EH, lemma-lift-map; cohomology.tex Tag 06YD, lemma-bounded-flat-K-flat

proof.text: Apply affine_koszul_section_colimit to obtain the perfect-object Hom diagram and its colimit cocone. Types.jointly_surjective extracts n and a derived map ξ representing s; the leg formula identifies s with inverse restricted augmentation followed by R(ξ).

Represent P_n by Q.objPreimage. DerivedCategory.right_fac factors its augmentation into a quasi-isomorphism denominator and an actual chain map. Apply exists_isKFlatResolution to the denominator source, compose the chain augmentation, and build c:Q(J)≅P_n from the two inverted quasi-isomorphisms. Functoriality and cancellation give Q(u)=c.hom followed by a_n. This is the fully proved private helper kflat_augmentation_realization.

For each local strictly perfect model of P_n, compose its model isomorphism with restriction of c to obtain a local model of Q(J). Compose the mapped c isomorphism with the restricted augmentation isomorphism to establish IsIso R(Q(u)). Finally rewrite the colimit leg formula, expand functor maps of composites, associate, and cancel augmentation followed by its inverse. This gives the displayed equation for ξ precomposed with c.hom. Empty U and zero objects use exactly the same proof.

theorem affine_koszul_section_roof
    (X : Scheme.{uX}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    letI := (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed X.sheaf).1.some
    let T := HomologicalComplex.tensorUnit
      (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    ∀ s : R.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj T) ⟶ R.obj E.obj,
      ∃ J : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) J ∧ IsPerfect X (DerivedCategory.Q.obj J) ∧
        ∃ (u : J ⟶ T) (ξ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj J ⟶ E.obj),
          IsIso (R.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map u)) ∧
          R.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map u) ≫ s = R.map ξ
